latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of webhook-workflow-builder.

- Automates webhook workflows for AI agents.
- Receive, validate, and process incoming webhooks.
- Transform payloads and route webhooks to different endpoints.
- Supports automatic retries, security verification, and event filtering.
- Logs full webhook delivery history and status.
- Includes command interface for registering webhooks, setting routing rules, and transforming payloads.
